units.rawText: So that's... Zero?
units.displayText: So that's... Zero?

spans.text: So that's... Zero?

units.rawText: I squint and try to peer at the figure. It has a humanoid silhouette while its head is lowered and lit from the rear, making it very difficult to see its face. Even so, it's fairly easy to tell that it does not have a fully-featured face.
units.displayText: I squint and try to peer at the figure. It has a humanoid silhouette while its head is lowered and lit from the rear, making it very difficult to see its face. Even so, it's fairly easy to tell that it does not have a fully-featured face.

spans.text: I squint and try to peer at the figure. It has a humanoid silhouette while its head is lowered and lit from the rear, making it very difficult to see its face. Even so, it's fairly easy to tell that it does not have a fully-featured face.

units.rawText: Also, its torso composed of steel bars and metal cables betrays its era of production.
units.displayText: Also, its torso composed of steel bars and metal cables betrays its era of production.

spans.text: Also, its torso composed of steel bars and metal cables betrays its era of production.

units.rawText: Hey, by Zero do you mean...
units.displayText: Hey, by Zero do you mean...

spans.text: Hey, by Zero do you mean...

units.rawText: Yup, the "Zero" who saved the village was probably just an antique without a neural cloud, an ordinary, old-school robot abandoned by the Military.
units.displayText: Yup, the "Zero" who saved the village was probably just an antique without a neural cloud, an ordinary, old-school robot abandoned by the Military.

spans.text: Yup, the "Zero" who saved the village was probably just an antique without a neural cloud, an ordinary, old-school robot abandoned by the Military.

units.rawText: So the legend of Zero helping the villagers with everything was...
units.displayText: So the legend of Zero helping the villagers with everything was...

spans.text: So the legend of Zero helping the villagers with everything was...

units.rawText: It was probably under orders from that Engineer fellow. Old-school robots like this can't carry out complex decision-making, so saying that it did everything it was told was very appropriate.
units.displayText: It was probably under orders from that Engineer fellow. Old-school robots like this can't carry out complex decision-making, so saying that it did everything it was told was very appropriate.

spans.text: It was probably under orders from that Engineer fellow. Old-school robots like this can't carry out complex decision-making, so saying that it did everything it was told was very appropriate.

units.rawText: So you're saying the villagers can't tell old-school robots apart from contemporary Dolls?
units.displayText: So you're saying the villagers can't tell old-school robots apart from contemporary Dolls?

spans.text: So you're saying the villagers can't tell old-school robots apart from contemporary Dolls?

units.rawText: Well, that makes sense. After all this place doesn't even have Internet access...
units.displayText: Well, that makes sense. After all this place doesn't even have Internet access...

spans.text: Well, that makes sense. After all this place doesn't even have Internet access...

units.rawText: Not just that, they had very little contact with Dolls too. I mean, they treated us as human beings when we first came to the village, right?
units.displayText: Not just that, they had very little contact with Dolls too. I mean, they treated us as human beings when we first came to the village, right?

spans.text: Not just that, they had very little contact with Dolls too. I mean, they treated us as human beings when we first came to the village, right?

units.rawText: They couldn't tell the difference because they haven't had much contact with Dolls.
units.displayText: They couldn't tell the difference because they haven't had much contact with Dolls.

spans.text: They couldn't tell the difference because they haven't had much contact with Dolls.

units.rawText: So this "Zero" was just a political symbol, then? A role model the Engineer propped up to unite the villagers?
units.displayText: So this "Zero" was just a political symbol, then? A role model the Engineer propped up to unite the villagers?

spans.text: So this "Zero" was just a political symbol, then? A role model the Engineer propped up to unite the villagers?

units.rawText: Not really. I think they're truly grateful to it. I mean, when you came it was treated as a good sign, right?
units.displayText: Not really. I think they're truly grateful to it. I mean, when you came it was treated as a good sign, right?

spans.text: Not really. I think they're truly grateful to it. I mean, when you came it was treated as a good sign, right?

units.rawText: How do you know that... You WERE stalking me, weren't you?
units.displayText: How do you know that... You WERE stalking me, weren't you?

spans.text: How do you know that... You WERE stalking me, weren't you?

units.rawText: I can't be bothered to do all that. It was Little Si that saw it.
units.displayText: I can't be bothered to do all that. It was Little Si that saw it.

spans.text: I can't be bothered to do all that. It was Little Si that saw it.

units.rawText: When she can't come up with a reason, she pushes all the blame onto that pet snake of hers.
units.displayText: When she can't come up with a reason, she pushes all the blame onto that pet snake of hers.

spans.text: When she can't come up with a reason, she pushes all the blame onto that pet snake of hers.

units.rawText: Okay, so we're their lucky star, but then why lock us up?
units.displayText: Okay, so we're their lucky star, but then why lock us up?

spans.text: Okay, so we're their lucky star, but then why lock us up?

units.rawText: (Sigh) There's a limit to how stupid one can be. Don't you get it yet?
units.displayText: (Sigh) There's a limit to how stupid one can be. Don't you get it yet?

spans.text: (Sigh) There's a limit to how stupid one can be. Don't you get it yet?

units.rawText: She presses her tongue to her teeth and sucks in a breath, hissing like a snake would.
units.displayText: She presses her tongue to her teeth and sucks in a breath, hissing like a snake would.

spans.text: She presses her tongue to her teeth and sucks in a breath, hissing like a snake would.

units.rawText: Listen up. All these people here, with the exception of the Engineer, are all refugees who've never been on the web before, right? So they don't know how Dolls work or what they need.
units.displayText: Listen up. All these people here, with the exception of the Engineer, are all refugees who've never been on the web before, right? So they don't know how Dolls work or what they need.

spans.text: Listen up. All these people here, with the exception of the Engineer, are all refugees who've never been on the web before, right? So they don't know how Dolls work or what they need.

units.rawText: Meanwhile, Zero, who helped build the village, is an unfeeling tin can.
units.displayText: Meanwhile, Zero, who helped build the village, is an unfeeling tin can.

spans.text: Meanwhile, Zero, who helped build the village, is an unfeeling tin can.

units.rawText: So what they feel for Dolls is simply what they feel for a tool. The adults treat us decently but the kids don't give a crap about us at all. It's just like how you're so obsessed with that crappy brush pen of yours.
units.displayText: So what they feel for Dolls is simply what they feel for a tool. The adults treat us decently but the kids don't give a crap about us at all. It's just like how you're so obsessed with that crappy brush pen of yours.

spans.text: So what they feel for Dolls is simply what they feel for a tool. The adults treat us decently but the kids don't give a crap about us at all. It's just like how you're so obsessed with that crappy brush pen of yours.

units.rawText: Oi, that comparison of yours... Well, I can understand why you'd say that. It does sort of make sense.
units.displayText: Oi, that comparison of yours... Well, I can understand why you'd say that. It does sort of make sense.

spans.text: Oi, that comparison of yours... Well, I can understand why you'd say that. It does sort of make sense.

units.rawText: Yup, so you won't mind if they make you do hard labor, right?
units.displayText: Yup, so you won't mind if they make you do hard labor, right?

spans.text: Yup, so you won't mind if they make you do hard labor, right?

units.rawText: I DO mind!
units.displayText: I DO mind!

spans.text: I DO mind!

units.rawText: According to tradition, Dolls bring good luck to Zero Village. Looks like we won't have to worry about food this year.
units.displayText: According to tradition, Dolls bring good luck to Zero Village. Looks like we won't have to worry about food this year.

spans.text: According to tradition, Dolls bring good luck to Zero Village. Looks like we won't have to worry about food this year.

units.rawText: Hm? Dolls are lucky...
units.displayText: Hm? Dolls are lucky...

spans.text: Hm? Dolls are lucky...

units.rawText: Now that's a rare tradition...
units.displayText: Now that's a rare tradition...

spans.text: Now that's a rare tradition...

units.rawText: Ah, I get it now! So THAT'S what they meant!
units.displayText: Ah, I get it now! So THAT'S what they meant!

spans.text: Ah, I get it now! So THAT'S what they meant!

units.rawText: No, wait, how do you know all this?
units.displayText: No, wait, how do you know all this?

spans.text: No, wait, how do you know all this?

units.rawText: As much as I hate to admit it, I overheard quite a bit of it when they kidnapped me and brought me here.
units.displayText: As much as I hate to admit it, I overheard quite a bit of it when they kidnapped me and brought me here.

spans.text: As much as I hate to admit it, I overheard quite a bit of it when they kidnapped me and brought me here.

units.rawText: They've got so many idle folk around yet they want others to work for them...
units.displayText: They've got so many idle folk around yet they want others to work for them...

spans.text: They've got so many idle folk around yet they want others to work for them...

units.rawText: But I'm a Cyber Media screenwriter! Surely it would make more sense to lock me up in some cell and write rather than have me move heavy loads around, right?
units.displayText: But I'm a Cyber Media screenwriter! Surely it would make more sense to lock me up in some cell and write rather than have me move heavy loads around, right?

spans.text: But I'm a Cyber Media screenwriter! Surely it would make more sense to lock me up in some cell and write rather than have me move heavy loads around, right?

units.rawText: Writing isn't nearly as valuable as carrying stuff in the wilderness.
units.displayText: Writing isn't nearly as valuable as carrying stuff in the wilderness.

spans.text: Writing isn't nearly as valuable as carrying stuff in the wilderness.

units.rawText: It doesn't matter what's inside your neural cloud. They only value a Doll's strength.
units.displayText: It doesn't matter what's inside your neural cloud. They only value a Doll's strength.

spans.text: It doesn't matter what's inside your neural cloud. They only value a Doll's strength.

units.rawText: And I also heard them say that once they use up Dolls, they strip them for parts and sell it off.
units.displayText: And I also heard them say that once they use up Dolls, they strip them for parts and sell it off.

spans.text: And I also heard them say that once they use up Dolls, they strip them for parts and sell it off.

units.rawText: Perhaps all those people who went missing are Dolls that they kidnapped.
units.displayText: Perhaps all those people who went missing are Dolls that they kidnapped.

spans.text: Perhaps all those people who went missing are Dolls that they kidnapped.

units.rawText: Dammit...
units.displayText: Dammit...

spans.text: Dammit...

units.rawText: Zangyin chuckles bitterly, and then leans against the metal bars. I can vaguely hear her hissing again.
units.displayText: Zangyin chuckles bitterly, and then leans against the metal bars. I can vaguely hear her hissing again.

spans.text: Zangyin chuckles bitterly, and then leans against the metal bars. I can vaguely hear her hissing again.

units.rawText: Ah, the star of the show is here.
units.displayText: Ah, the star of the show is here.

spans.text: Ah, the star of the show is here.

units.rawText: Thud—
units.displayText: Thud—

spans.text: Thud—

units.rawText: Two villagers open the door to the cellar and a man enters. He's wearing a strange-looking outfit that's clearly pieced together from components made by different manufacturers.
units.displayText: Two villagers open the door to the cellar and a man enters. He's wearing a strange-looking outfit that's clearly pieced together from components made by different manufacturers.

spans.text: Two villagers open the door to the cellar and a man enters. He's wearing a strange-looking outfit that's clearly pieced together from components made by different manufacturers.

units.rawText: Boss, they're the ones.
units.displayText: Boss, they're the ones.

spans.text: Boss, they're the ones.

units.rawText: We treated them well like you asked us to. We were worried they'd run off before long, so we called you back ahead of time.
units.displayText: We treated them well like you asked us to. We were worried they'd run off before long, so we called you back ahead of time.

spans.text: We treated them well like you asked us to. We were worried they'd run off before long, so we called you back ahead of time.

units.rawText: But, heh, in the end they came to us on their own.
units.displayText: But, heh, in the end they came to us on their own.

spans.text: But, heh, in the end they came to us on their own.

units.rawText: It's fine. You did well.
units.displayText: It's fine. You did well.

spans.text: It's fine. You did well.

units.rawText: Allow me to introduce myself, though you may already know me. I am the Engineer.
units.displayText: Allow me to introduce myself, though you may already know me. I am the Engineer.

spans.text: Allow me to introduce myself, though you may already know me. I am the Engineer.

units.rawText: While I don't know why you came here, it is no longer important. After all, making humans happy is a Doll's lot, isn't it?
units.displayText: While I don't know why you came here, it is no longer important. After all, making humans happy is a Doll's lot, isn't it?

spans.text: While I don't know why you came here, it is no longer important. After all, making humans happy is a Doll's lot, isn't it?

units.rawText: In that case, we'll have to trouble you to work hard for the happiness of Zero Village.
units.displayText: In that case, we'll have to trouble you to work hard for the happiness of Zero Village.

spans.text: In that case, we'll have to trouble you to work hard for the happiness of Zero Village.

units.rawText: With that, the Engineer activates a device he is holding. The modules around his wrist chug into action.
units.displayText: With that, the Engineer activates a device he is holding. The modules around his wrist chug into action.

spans.text: With that, the Engineer activates a device he is holding. The modules around his wrist chug into action.

units.rawText: The modules emit a scanner-like beam which sweeps over Zangyin and me.
units.displayText: The modules emit a scanner-like beam which sweeps over Zangyin and me.

spans.text: The modules emit a scanner-like beam which sweeps over Zangyin and me.

units.rawText: Firearms? No... High-energy devices? Also no...
units.displayText: Firearms? No... High-energy devices? Also no...

spans.text: Firearms? No... High-energy devices? Also no...

units.rawText: Why don't these Dolls have anything? Did you guys decide to help yourselves to trophies while I wasn't around?
units.displayText: Why don't these Dolls have anything? Did you guys decide to help yourselves to trophies while I wasn't around?

spans.text: Why don't these Dolls have anything? Did you guys decide to help yourselves to trophies while I wasn't around?

units.rawText: How could we? Boss, we wouldn't dare do anything like that! We just knocked them out and dragged them here. We didn't dare touch them.
units.displayText: How could we? Boss, we wouldn't dare do anything like that! We just knocked them out and dragged them here. We didn't dare touch them.

spans.text: How could we? Boss, we wouldn't dare do anything like that! We just knocked them out and dragged them here. We didn't dare touch them.

units.rawText: Don't you remember, Boss? One of our bros barely touched the hand of that Doll from before and he got his eye shot out.
units.displayText: Don't you remember, Boss? One of our bros barely touched the hand of that Doll from before and he got his eye shot out.

spans.text: Don't you remember, Boss? One of our bros barely touched the hand of that Doll from before and he got his eye shot out.

units.rawText: Tsk...
units.displayText: Tsk...

spans.text: Tsk...

units.rawText: Annoyed, the Engineer takes out another scanner cobbled together from who knows what and sweeps it over us again.
units.displayText: Annoyed, the Engineer takes out another scanner cobbled together from who knows what and sweeps it over us again.

spans.text: Annoyed, the Engineer takes out another scanner cobbled together from who knows what and sweeps it over us again.

units.rawText: Never mind then, go ahead and scrap them. It's not like they pose a threat to us anyway.
units.displayText: Never mind then, go ahead and scrap them. It's not like they pose a threat to us anyway.

spans.text: Never mind then, go ahead and scrap them. It's not like they pose a threat to us anyway.

units.rawText: Crackle—
units.displayText: Crackle—

spans.text: Crackle—

units.rawText: The frame freezes at the exact moment before the two villagers move up to obey.
units.displayText: The frame freezes at the exact moment before the two villagers move up to obey.

spans.text: The frame freezes at the exact moment before the two villagers move up to obey.
